name: n8n
description: Fair-code workflow automation: connect apps, transform data, build agents. Self-hosted Zapier alternative.
compose:
services:
  n8n:
    image: n8nio/n8n:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:5678"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/home/node/.n8n
    environment:
      GENERIC_TIMEZONE: "UTC"
    restart: unless-stopped
